description: This file defines vectorized operations for uint8_t and uint16_t types using ARM NEON intrinsics, including class templates, operator overloads, and utility functions for vectorized computations within the at::vec namespace.

classes.name: Vectorized<uint8_t>
classes.description: Template class for 128-bit vectorized uint8_t operations using ARM NEON intrinsics.

classes.name: Vectorized<uint16_t>
classes.description: Template class for 128-bit vectorized uint16_t operations using ARM NEON intrinsics.

methods.name: Vectorized<uint8_t>::loadu
methods.description: Loads unaligned data into a vectorized uint8_t object.

methods.name: Vectorized<uint8_t>::store
methods.description: Stores vectorized uint8_t data into memory.

methods.name: Vectorized<uint8_t>::arange
methods.description: Creates a range of uint8_t values with a specified step.
